text:
finapp-prod: hey team — since 00:15 we started seeing a pile of 429s and auth failures hitting our dedicated pool. customers complaining about timeouts and billing jumping. logs show repeated 'KV_NOT_FOUND -> eviction' path. :frowning:
jen: thanks — can you paste the root request ID and example headers? are these long-context chat sessions? :eyes:
finapp-prod: example req: id=req_83b7a9, X-Auth: ok, but response is 429 from router -> backend says 'kv cache pressure'. typical payloads are 150k token sequences (multi-turn transcript). we suspect sticky sessions with long prefixes.
samir: sounds like session-cache churn. our KV slab allocator is seeing high fragmentation from many long ctxs pinned by active users. eviction rate spiked: eviction/sec 1200 -> 3x baseline. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/kv/evict?orgId=1 :fire:
leo: is autoscale not catching up? what does pool_util look like + queued reqs?
ops-bot: Alert: dedicated-pool-prod-5 kv_eviction_rate high (fired at 2026-03-12T00:16:02Z). links: alert/evict-high
tori: autoscale saw a delayed upscale because the policy uses 1m commit window + cooldown 5m. traffic bursts were sub-minute so we underprovisioned. short-term mitigation: enable cache-prefetch/prefix-caching and lower per-request max_context to 32k for that tenant.
jen: can we get a repro in staging? what minimal steps to trigger?
samir: reproduce steps i used:
1) open 8 concurrent sessions with long history (120k tokens) hitting the same tenant
2) send streaming requests with KV-prefetch disabled
3) run: ```for i in {1..8}; do curl -X POST https://dedicated.redwood/api/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload$i.json & done``` payload has long messages
expected: queue grows, eviction/sec climbs, 429s appear when cache saturation hits.
leo: logs from req_83b7a9:
```
[2026-03-12T00:15:42Z] req_83b7a9 INFO route=start tenant=finapp pool=prod-5
[2026-03-12T00:15:42Z] req_83b7a9 WARN kv_cache miss prefix=chat:session:usr_44 size=128k
[2026-03-12T00:15:44Z] req_83b7a9 ERROR eviction failed slab_compact_needed
[2026-03-12T00:15:44Z] req_83b7a9 RESPONSE 429 "kv cache pressure"
```
tori: for immediate relief we can: 1) bump dedicated-pool-prod-5 min_replicas by +1 (fast), 2) enable prefix cache TTL trimming for that tenant, 3) set tenant max_context=32k. then follow with a slab compaction maintenance window.
jen: agree. samir — can you run compaction and coordinate an infra bump? i'll patch the tenant config and X-FF to enable prefix-ttl.
samir: starting compaction now, will also toggle prefix-ttl. doing a quick scale `kubectl scale deploy/dedicated-prod-5 --replicas=6 -n inference` :white_check_mark:
finapp-prod: thanks — will monitor. any billing implications for the customer? they already flagged cost spike.
leo: yes cost will rise for the bumped minute(s). we should post a cost note to billing and offer a credit if sustained. @ops-bot can you open invoice-impact ticket?
ops-bot: Created ticket INC-4729: "FinApp billing spike due to autoscale + cache pressure" and linked thread.
jen: next actions: (a) confirm 429s drop (b) collect heap/kv metrics for 1h (c) schedule slab compaction maintenance (d) follow up with customer by EOD. assign: samir (a,c), tori (b), jen (d).
finapp-prod: got it — we're seeing fewer 429s already, thanks. will share any new repros. :thumbsup:
